text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey! Yuki, you like cake,
right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go check out that new cake
shop by the
station!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The super spiffy one?! You sure
you wanna
go with me?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That shop's super-duper eeextra cute,
right? Then
you'll fit right in!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Awww! Y-you sure know how
t'sweet-talk a girl!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, why not! I can't turn down such a
swell
inv'tation! Look out, cakes, here I
come!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, then it's settled! Those sweet
treats will
soon be ours! ♪
